## Overview

The KOL Lecture Series has been running since 2015 with a mission to invite thought leaders to share insights on the methodology, application, and practical considerations of innovative clinical trial designs. The series is organized by a rotating volunteer committee.

**Format:** Monthly webinars, Fridays 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM EST

**Attendance:** 100–200 participants per session, open to all.

**Chairs:** Heng Zhou (Merck), Yi Pan (Bristol Myers Squibb)

**Members:** John Loewy (Data ForeThought), Xiaofei Bai (Moderna)

**Join a session:** [Zoom link](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87688020761?pwd=VHBWb1NPcFlZTXI5cTNLeVRwOUlYZz09){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

## 2025 Schedule and Archive

See the [Events & KOL Lectures](../events.qmd) page for the full 2025 schedule and a listing of past speakers dating back to 2020.

## Propose a Speaker

The committee is actively seeking speakers for 2026. To propose a speaker or express interest in presenting, contact any committee member, contact details available through the [leadership team](../join.qmd).
